name: outsl
synopsis: void outsl(unsigned short port, const void *addr, unsigned long count);
description: The outsl function performs low-level output of a string of long words from memory to the specified I/O port. It is primarily intended for internal kernel use but can be accessed from user space with proper permissions.

parameters.name: port
parameters.description: The I/O port to which data is output.

parameters.name: addr
parameters.description: Pointer to the memory buffer containing the data to output.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: The number of long words to output.

return_value.failure: May cause segmentation fault if I/O permissions are not set

errors.description: Segmentation fault if the application lacks permission to access the I/O port
